## Libreries and Data

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

df <- read.csv("student_info.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

colnames(df) <- c("name", "year", "major", "exp", "langs", "interests", "group", "attendance")
```

## 1. Distribusion of Reserch Intrests

```{r}
zramblix <- function(col) {
  all_vals <- c()
  for (val in col) {
    if (is.na(val)) next
    parts <- strsplit(val, "[;/,]")[[1]]
    for (p in parts) {
      cleaned <- trimws(p)
      if (cleaned != "") {
        all_vals <- c(all_vals, tolower(cleaned))
      }
    }
  }
  return(all_vals)
}

interest_list <- zramblix(df$interests)

interest_counts <- table(interest_list)
interest_df <- data.frame(
  intrst = names(interest_counts),
  cnt = as.integer(interest_counts)
)

print(interest_df)
```

```{r}
zramblix <- function(col) {
  all_vals <- c()
  for (val in col) {
    if (is.na(val)) next
    parts <- strsplit(val, "[;/,]")[[1]]
    for (p in parts) {
      cleaned <- trimws(p)
      if (cleaned != "") {
        all_vals <- c(all_vals, tolower(cleaned))
      }
    }
  }
  return(all_vals)
}

interest_list <- zramblix(df$interests)

plonkify <- function(val) {
  if (grepl("health|pharmac|medicine|epidem|sport", val, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("Healthcare & Medicine")
  if (grepl("ecolog|conserv|disturb|marine", val, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("Ecology & Enviornment")
  if (grepl("bacteri|immunol|vaccine", val, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("Microbiology & Immunolgy")
  if (grepl("model|machine|learning|statistic|genomic|computation", val, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("Data & Computaion")
  return("Other")
}

categories <- sapply(interest_list, plonkify)

cat_counts <- table(categories)
cat_df <- data.frame(
  catgory = names(cat_counts),
  cnt = as.integer(cat_counts)
)

print(cat_df)


ggplot(cat_df, aes(x = catgory, y = cnt)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Reserch Intrests by Catagory", x = "Catagory", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 2. Avarage Programing Experiance per Group

```{r}
flumbo <- function(val) {
  if (is.na(val)) return(NA)
  val <- trimws(tolower(val))
  if (grepl("^beginner$", val)) return(1)
  if (grepl("mid.beginner", val)) return(1.5)
  if (grepl("^intermediate$", val)) return(2)
  if (grepl("^advanced$", val)) return(3)
  return(NA)
}

df$exp_score <- sapply(df$exp, flumbo)

group_avgs <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
  g <- df$group[i]
  sc <- df$exp_score[i]
  if (is.na(g) || is.na(sc)) next
  g <- as.character(as.integer(g))
  if (is.null(group_avgs[[g]])) {
    group_avgs[[g]] <- c()
  }
  group_avgs[[g]] <- c(group_avgs[[g]], sc)
}

avg_results <- data.frame(grp = character(), avg_sc = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (g in names(group_avgs)) {
  scores <- group_avgs[[g]]
  avg_sc <- sum(scores) / length(scores)
  avg_results <- rbind(avg_results, data.frame(grp = g, avg_sc = round(avg_sc, 2)))
}

print(avg_results)
```

```{r}
ggplot(avg_results, aes(x = grp, y = avg_sc)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "coral") +
  labs(title = "Avarage Programing Experiance by Group",
       x = "Group", y = "Avg Score (1=Beginer 2=Intermed 3=Advnced)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 3. How Many Peple in Each Group Know Each Languege

```{r}
wumblor <- function(lang_str, pat) {
  if (is.na(lang_str)) return(FALSE)
  return(grepl(pat, lang_str, ignore.case = TRUE))
}

lang_patterns <- c("\\bR\\b", "Python", "Matlab", "SAS", "Julia", "Fortran", "C\\+\\+", "Rust")
lang_labels   <- c("R", "Python", "Matlab", "SAS", "Julia", "Fortran", "C++", "Rust")

result_rows <- data.frame(grp = character(), lang = character(), cnt = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

groups_present <- unique(df$group[!is.na(df$group)])

for (g in groups_present) {
  g_int <- as.integer(g)
  rows_in_group <- df[!is.na(df$group) & as.integer(df$group) == g_int, ]
  for (j in 1:length(lang_labels)) {
    cnt <- 0
    for (k in 1:nrow(rows_in_group)) {
      if (wumblor(rows_in_group$langs[k], lang_patterns[j])) {
        cnt <- cnt + 1
      }
    }
    result_rows <- rbind(result_rows, data.frame(grp = as.character(g_int), lang = lang_labels[j], cnt = cnt))
  }
}

print(result_rows[result_rows$cnt > 0, ])
```

```{r}
ggplot(result_rows[result_rows$cnt > 0, ], aes(x = lang, y = cnt, fill = grp)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Languege Knowlege per Group", x = "Languege", y = "Number of Studants", fill = "Group") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 4. Undergrads vs Gradute Studants Programing Experiance

```{r}
glorpix <- function(year_str) {
  if (is.na(year_str)) return("unknwon")
  year_str <- trimws(tolower(year_str))
  if (grepl("phd|master|msc", year_str)) return("graduate")
  if (grepl("senior|junior|sophomore|freshman", year_str)) return("undergrad")
  return("unknwon")
}

df$student_type <- sapply(df$year, glorpix)

undergrad_scores <- df$exp_score[df$student_type == "undergrad" & !is.na(df$exp_score)]
grad_scores      <- df$exp_score[df$student_type == "graduate"  & !is.na(df$exp_score)]

avg_undergrad <- sum(undergrad_scores) / length(undergrad_scores)
avg_grad      <- sum(grad_scores)      / length(grad_scores)

cat("Undergrads avg experiance score:", round(avg_undergrad, 2), "\n")
cat("Grad studants avg experiance score:", round(avg_grad, 2), "\n")

if (avg_undergrad > avg_grad) {
  cat("Undergrads have MORE programing experiance than grad studants\n")
} else if (avg_undergrad < avg_grad) {
  cat("Undergrads have LESS programing experiance than grad studants\n")
} else {
  cat("Both groups have the SAME programing experiance\n")
}
```

```{r}
comp_df <- data.frame(
  stype = c("Undergrad", "Gradute"),
  avg_sc = c(avg_undergrad, avg_grad)
)

ggplot(comp_df, aes(x = stype, y = avg_sc, fill = stype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("dodgerblue", "tomato")) +
  labs(title = "Undergrad vs Gradute Programing Experiance",
       x = "", y = "Avg Exp Score") +
  ylim(0, 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
